Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check EB1/2 application due to loss of vehicle integrity.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check EB1/2 application due to loss of vehicle integrity.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.
- Passenger Alarm is not activated in the vehicle.
- Tear Off Brake Bypass Switch 33S02 NOT operated in any Cab.
- Sufficient Track length available for vehicle movement.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at slow speed (approx. 3 Kmph)
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Operate Tear Off Brake Bypass Switch 33S02
Operation of Tear Off Brake Bypass Switch 33S02 is recorded in Event Recorder.

In C2 Car:
- Simulate loss of vehicle integrity by removing the cable 33220.03 from Relay Coil terminal 33K12: 2(+)
In non-Active CABIN:
- Connect +24Vdc supply to relays 62K01 (X1) and 62K02 (X1)
Nothing happens. vehicle continue to move.

In Active CABIN:
- Reset Tear Off Brake Bypass Switch 33S02
Emergency Brakes are applied in both the Cars.
Check Inputs
DELETED

On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" 
symbol will illuminate.

On Loop Screen in HMI following information is showed
"Traction inhibited : Emergency Brake 1/2"
"Brake Loop: Loss of integrity between units"

In Active CABIN:
- Wait for the vehicle to Stop.
- Slowly move the master controller forward (towards Traction region).
Nothing happens. Traction is inhibited & vehicle remains at Standstill.

In C2 Car:
- Re-connect back  the cable 33220.03 into the Relay Coil terminal 33K12: 2(+)
In non-Active CABIN:
- Normalize relays 62K01 and 62K02
DELETED
Check Inputs
Emergency Brakes are released.
On Drive Control Screen in HMI, "EB applied" symbol will be OFF.

On Loop Screen in HMI messages dissapeared
"Traction inhibited : Emergency Brake 1/2"
"Brake Loop: Loss of integrity between units"
Check alarm

PROPULSION/BRAKE  handle in COAST.
Press SIFA PB in the handle and release it
DELETED
Alarm Reset.

In Active CABIN:
- Slowly move the master controller forward (towards Traction region).
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller back to Coasting region and apply service brake.
vehicle Stops.

DELETED
DELETED
DELETED
DELETED

vehicle starts moving.

vehicle Stops.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Track Brake application in normal scenario.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Track Brake application in normal scenario.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.
- Sufficient Track length available for vehicle movement.

test_actions.text:

- Press electromagnetic brake application button (37S01) located on the supplementary handle.
Track Brakes are NOT applied in the vehicle.
Check Input

- Release the electromagnetic brake application button (37S01)

vehicle starts moving.

Track Brakes are applied in the vehicle.
Check Input

In Non-active CABIN:
-Release the electromagnetic brake application button (37S01)
In Active CABIN:
- Move the master controller back to Coasting region and apply service brake.
vehicle Stops.
Track Brakes are released. Check Input

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Track Brake application in case of BCU failure.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Track Brake application in case of BCU failure.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.
- Sufficient Track length available for vehicle movement.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at a speed of approx. 5 Kmph.
vehicle starts moving.

In C1 Car:
- Simulate failure of the failure of the TCU by switching off MCB 21Q01
Nothing happens.

In C2 Car:
- Simulate failure of the of the TCU by switching off MCB 21Q01
- Simulate failure of 2 BCUs by switching off MCBs 30Q01 & 30Q02
Check Alarm
Track Brakes are applied in the vehicle. Check Input
DELETED

- Wait for the vehicle to stop.
In C2 Car:
- Reset MCBs 30Q01 & 30Q02
Track Brakes are released. Check Input
Alarm Reset.

In C1 Car:
- Reset MCB 21Q01
In C2 Car:
- Reset MCB 21Q01

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check failures of Track Brake contactors.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check failures of Track Brake contactors.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.
- Sufficient Track length available for vehicle movement.

test_actions.text:
In C1 Car:
- Remove Cable 37121.01 from Contactor terminal 37K01: A1
Nothing happens.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at a speed of approx. 5 Kmph.
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Press electromagnetic brake application button (37S01) located on the supplementary handle.
Track Brakes are applied in Trailer Bogie and Motor Bogie of C2 only.
Check Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- Release electromagnetic brake application button (37S01).
- Apply Service Brake to Stop the vehicle.
vehicle Stops.

In C1 Car:
- Re-Connect back the Cable 37121.01 into the Contactor terminal 37K01: A1
Nothing happens.

In C1 Car:
- Remove below cables:
(a) Cable 37252.02 from Contactor terminal 37K02: 3/L2
(b) Cable 37261.02 from Contactor terminal 37K02: 7/L4
Nothing happens.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at a speed of approx. 5 Kmph.
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Press electromagnetic brake application button (37S01) located on the supplementary handle.
Track Brakes are applied in Motor Bogie of C1 and Motor Bogie of C2 only.
Previous Alarm Reset.
Check New Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- Release electromagnetic brake application button (37S01).
- Apply Service Brake to Stop the vehicle.
vehicle Stops.

In C1 Car:
- Re-Connect back the below Cables removed earlier:
(a) Cable 37252.02 into the Contactor terminal 37K02: 3/L2
(b) Cable 37261.02 into the Contactor terminal 37K02: 7/L4
Nothing happens.

In C2 Car:
- Remove Cable 37121.01 from Contactor terminal 37K01: A1
Nothing happens.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at a speed of approx. 5 Kmph.
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Press electromagnetic brake application button (37S01) located on the supplementary handle.
Track Brakes are applied in Trailer Bogie and Motor Bogie of C1 only.
Previous Alarm Reset.
Check New Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- Release electromagnetic brake application button (37S01).
- Apply Service Brake to Stop the vehicle.
vehicle Stops.

In C2 Car:
- Re-connect back the Cable 37121.01 into the Contactor terminal 37K01: A1
Nothing happens.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at a speed of approx. 5 Kmph.
vehicle starts moving.

In Active CABIN:
- Press electromagnetic brake application button (37S01) located on the supplementary handle.
Track Brakes are applied in all the Bogies.
Alarm Reset.

In Active CABIN:
- Reset electromagnetic brake application button (37S01).
- Apply Service Brake to Stop the vehicle.
vehicle Stops.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Parking Brake application when vehicle is at Standstill.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check Parking Brake application when vehicle is at Standstill.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- Press the Parking Brake pushbutton (32S02)
Safety Brakes are applied in the vehicle.
Brake application status is shown on HMI.

In Active CABIN:
- Press the Parking Brake pushbutton (32S02) again
Safety Brakes are release in the vehicle.
Brake application status dissapears on HMI.

In Active CABIN:
- Move the Cab Activation key switch to "0" position.
Cab is de-activated.
Safety Brakes are applied in the vehicle.

In CABIN:
- Move the Cab Activation key switch to "1" position.
Cab is activated.
Safety Brakes are release in the vehicle.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Auxiliary Release of Parking Brakes
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Auxiliary Release of Parking Brakes
initial_conditions: - HV is connected to the vehicle
- Local Cab is Active and Forward  Direction selected.

test_actions.text:
In C1 Car:
- Remove Cable 33622.02 from TB XT43.101: 05a
Parking (Safety) Brake is applied in Motor Bogie C1.

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, select the virtual pushbutton for Motor Bogie C1.
- Operate Parking Brake Bypass Switch 32S06.
Check Variables
Check Alarm
Wait for approx. 30 seconds
Motor Bogie Safety Brake is hydraulically released.
Check Variables
Check Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- Reset Parking Brake Bypass Switch 32S06.
Motor Bogie Safety Brake is applied again.
Check Variables
Alarms Reset.

In C1 Car:
- Re-connect back the Cable 33622.02 in the TB XT43.101: 05a
Parking Brake is released in Motor Bogie C1.

In C2 Car:
- Remove Cable 33652.03 from TB XT43.101: 19b
Parking (Safety) Brake is applied in Trailer Bogie.

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, select the virtual pushbutton for Trailer Bogie.
- Operate Parking Brake Bypass Switch 32S06.
Check Variables
Check Alarm
Wait for approx. 30 seconds
Trailer Bogie Safety Brake is hydraulically released.
Check Variables
Check Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- Reset Parking Brake Bypass Switch 32S06.
Trailer Bogie Safety Brake is applied again.
Check Variables
Alarms Reset.

In C2 Car:
- Re-connect back the Cable 33652.03 in the TB XT43.101: 19b
Parking Brake is released in Trailer Bogie.

In C2 Car:
- Remove Cable 33622.02 from TB XT43.101: 07a
Parking (Safety) Brake is applied in Motor Bogie C2.

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, select the virtual pushbutton for Motor Bogie C2.
- Operate Parking Brake Bypass Switch 32S06.
Check Variables
Check Alarm
Wait for approx. 30 seconds
Motor Bogie Safety Brake is hydraulically released.
Check Variables
Check Alarm

In Active CABIN:
- Reset Parking Brake Bypass Switch 32S06.
Motor Bogie Safety Brake is applied again.
Check Variables
Alarms Reset.

In C2 Car:
- Re-connect back the Cable 33622.02 in the TB XT43.101: 07a
Parking Brake is released in Motor Bogie C2.
